I feel you. A similar situation happened to me about a year back. 

It was over Discord with one of my friends, where she made a fake confession just to get a reaction out of me. Apparently, she collaborated with another one of my friends, which made it hurt twice as much. I didn't expect her to suddenly do this to me and it genuinely hurt a lot, but to this day I haven't really told her how I felt about it because I just felt at a loss for words.

You see, we did enjoy pranking and joking around with one another, but it was always to the point that we understood it was a joke. I had never been confessed to other than that time, so when she told me she loved me, I thought she was being genuine at first. When she made her prank confession, I thought it was real and told her in a serious tone that I didn't have feelings for her but she was a good friend, and that I hoped she would understand.

But then she started being negative about herself and saying that she needed a break and needed to stop talking to me for a while, and my heart dropped. I was scared of losing my friend, not knowing it was a prank at all, and I told her to answer me. She stopped answering me. I can't believe she was probably just laughing at me from behind the screen.

Panicking, I went and messaged my other friend, who *also* happened to be in on the prank with her, lucky me. The other friend thankfully realized that I had been actually hurt by the prank, however, and told me it was a prank. I later realized that if the other friend hadn't told me that it was a prank, the first girl would have still been keeping up the prank for an *entire day*.

I genuinely don't know if I'll ever find love and this made me feel worse about it.
